tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The catalog has no compression entry, and `muninn why` came back "insufficient". The only compression-related history is two bare, context-free one-word messages, "gzip" and then "zstd". Both are low-trust episodes rather than recorded decisions, and neither states a choice or a replacement. I didn't treat either one as a decision.

The first attempt to create the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. The file was written successfully.
